"""Add sparkline-style mini charts to column F for each Order ID row."""
import io
import os
import shutil

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.drawing.image import Image as XLImage
from openpyxl.utils.units import pixels_to_EMU
from openpyxl.drawing.spreadsheet_drawing import (
    OneCellAnchor,
    AnchorMarker,
)
from openpyxl.drawing.xdr import XDRPositiveSize2D

SRC = "/home/user/OrderId_Month_Chart.xlsx"
BACKUP = "/home/user/OrderId_Month_Chart.bak.xlsx"
TMP_DIR = "/tmp/sparkline_imgs"

os.makedirs(TMP_DIR, exist_ok=True)
if not os.path.exists(BACKUP):
    shutil.copy(SRC, BACKUP)

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(SRC)
ws = wb.active

# Make column F wider and rows taller for the sparkline images
ws.column_dimensions["F"].width = 22  # ~ 154 px
for row in range(2, 24):
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 28  # ~ 37 px

# Image size in pixels
IMG_W_PX = 150
IMG_H_PX = 32

def make_sparkline_png(values, out_path):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(IMG_W_PX / 100, IMG_H_PX / 100), dpi=100)
    ax.plot(values, color="#1f77b4", linewidth=1.6, marker="o",
            markersize=3, markerfacecolor="#1f77b4", markeredgecolor="#1f77b4")
    # highlight min and max
    vmin_i = values.index(min(values))
    vmax_i = values.index(max(values))
    ax.plot(vmin_i, values[vmin_i], "o", color="#d62728", markersize=4)
    ax.plot(vmax_i, values[vmax_i], "o", color="#2ca02c", markersize=4)
    ax.set_axis_off()
    ax.margins(x=0.08, y=0.20)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0, right=1, top=1, bottom=0)
    fig.savefig(out_path, dpi=100, transparent=True)
    plt.close(fig)

# Iterate rows 2..23, columns C,D,E
for r in range(2, 24):
    jan = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    feb = ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value
    mar = ws.cell(row=r, column=5).value
    values = [float(jan), float(feb), float(mar)]
    img_path = os.path.join(TMP_DIR, f"sparkline_{r}.png")
    make_sparkline_png(values, img_path)

    img = XLImage(img_path)
    img.width = IMG_W_PX
    img.height = IMG_H_PX

    # Anchor centered inside cell F{r}: column index 5 (0-based), row index r-1
    col_idx = 5  # F
    row_idx = r - 1
    # Small inset offsets so the image sits inside cell padding
    col_off_emu = pixels_to_EMU(4)
    row_off_emu = pixels_to_EMU(3)
    marker = AnchorMarker(col=col_idx, colOff=col_off_emu,
                          row=row_idx, rowOff=row_off_emu)
    size = XDRPositiveSize2D(cx=pixels_to_EMU(IMG_W_PX),
                             cy=pixels_to_EMU(IMG_H_PX))
    img.anchor = OneCellAnchor(_from=marker, ext=size)
    ws.add_image(img)

wb.save(SRC)
print("Saved with sparklines.")
